title: TF-IDF
seoDescription: Build a vocabulary V sorted alphabetically and compute the TF-IDF score for every term in every document.
description:
Compute Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) feature representations over an alphabetical vocabulary.

TF-IDF balances term local prevalence against global corpus uniqueness, suppressing generic stop words.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
\operatorname{TF-IDF}(t, d) = \frac{f_{t, d}}{|d|} \times \left( \log\frac{N}{\operatorname{DF}(t)} + 1 \right)
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Construct alphabetically sorted unique vocabulary across all documents
2. Compute document frequencies and inverse document frequencies (IDF)
3. Calculate relative term frequencies and multiply by IDF weights

### Returns
Dictionary with 'vocabulary' list and 'tfidf_matrix' rows.

## The Mathematical Formulation

$$
\operatorname{TF-IDF}(t, d) = \frac{f_{t, d}}{|d|} \times \left( \log\frac{N}{\operatorname{DF}(t)} + 1 \right)
$$
